Name: NPC March Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
chocolatte12's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32889]Custom NPC- March from Fields of Mistria[/url] was a mod I really liked and was excited to see grow. Sadly, chocolatte is no longer maintaining him. But, I was able to reach out and get permission to revive him! So, here he is! March is BACK!

﻿My main goal of this was to make him compatible with Arknir27's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307]Lucikiel[/url] NPC, but as March and Lucikiel both lived at the smithy they weren't really compatible. So to fix that, my major change from the original March mod is that he now requires ottersqueak's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30194]Saloon Second Floor[/url]. He lives in the first smaller room on the bottom left. No custom touches yet but it's in the plans!

[s]Further development plans include developing more dialogue, working his expressions more, making him marriageable, developing a spouse room, all that jazz. But for now, you can just enjoy his moody lil booty in the valley﻿.[/s]
March is now marriageable with a custom spouse room!

Likes/Dislikes:
Love: Gold bar, iridium bar, maki roll, star shard
Like: Copper bar, iron bar, coffee, chocolate cake, beer, gold ore, copper ore, fried eel
Dislike: flowers
Hated: red mullet

Heart Events:
2 hearts - After reaching 2 hearts, March will send you a letter. After reading the letter, enter the blacksmith's while it's open.
4 hearts - Enter the blacksmith's while its open
6 hearts - To be added
8 hearts - Enter the town between 8pm-midnight.
10 hearts - After reaching 10 hearts, March will send you a letter. After reading the letter, go to the mountain after 7pm.

Most days he can be found either in his room or hard at work in the forge, but he does wander around town some. And yes, he is SVE compatible! In fact he should be compatible with most of the big expansions, and if he isn't, I'll try and make it so he is in the future. 

Enjoy!
